title: Closeout summary: S04T02 - Update generated skill adapters for directive consumption
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

S04T02 updated generated skill adapter contracts for agent directives. Source skills now require inspecting agentDirectives, handling required/blocking directives, reporting conflicts/deprecations/missingRequired IDs, and treating runtime fields as typed data. Workflow asset validation now rejects source or installed skills missing those markers, and Codex/Claude installed skill checks plus tests cover the contract.

Close reason: Generated skill adapters now consume trusted directive bundles and validation gates passed
